content: {"summary":"Before reducing a Kafka topic's retention you should verify broker volumes, identify large topics, check consumer lag, confirm the topic’s cleanup policy and segment state, understand retention.bytes scope, and respect audit‑critical topics like ledger.entries.","likely_cause":"Not applicable – the question asks for pre‑change checks, not a cause of an incident.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Confirm which broker and which volume before changing retention","evidence_ids":["RB-009#1"],"quote":"Confirm which broker and which volume."},{"text":"Identify the biggest topics consuming disk space","evidence_ids":["RB-009#1"],"quote":"Find the biggest topics. ``` kafka-log-di"},{"text":"Verify consumer lag so no unread messages are dropped","evidence_ids":["RB-009#2"],"quote":"Check consumers before you shorten anything."},{"text":"Retention only removes closed segments; active segments stay","evidence_ids":["RB-009#5"],"quote":"Retention only removes closed segments."},{"text":"Active segment of each partition is never deleted","evidence_ids":["RB-009#5"],"quote":"The active segment of each partition is never deleted."},{"text":"Retention.bytes applies per partition, not per topic","evidence_ids":["RB-009#5"],"quote":"`retention.bytes` is per partition, not per topic."},{"text":"Do not shorten ledger.entries retention without audit approval","evidence_ids":["RB-009#5"],"quote":"ledger.entries has a 14-day retention for audit reasons."}],"next_checks":["Run `df -h /data/kafka` on each broker after the change to monitor free space","Watch the broker’s retention cleanup for 10‑15 minutes (e.g., `Watch df -h /data/kafka`)","Confirm the topic’s `cleanup.policy` is not `compact` before relying on retention.ms","Check `segment.ms` and `segment.bytes` settings to ensure segments will roll promptly","Validate that replication factor and min.insync.replicas remain satisfied after space is freed"]}
